$ send-mail compose --to a@example.com --subject x --body a --body-file $TMP/note.txt
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
send-mail: error: --body and --body-file can't be used together
Usage: send-mail compose --to=ADDRESS,... --subject=SUBJECT (--body=BODY | --body-file=FILE) [flags]
Run "send-mail compose --help" for details.
